convert_upernet_checkpoint: convert a mmsegmentation Swin UperNet checkpoint to PyTorch HuggingFace format for tiny, small, base, or large variants
create_rename_keys: create key renaming rules to map mmsegmentation Swin UperNet checkpoint keys to HuggingFace UperNetForSemanticSegmentation keys
read_in_q_k_v: split combined qkv projection weights into separate query, key, and value weight tensors for attention layers
get_upernet_config: generate a UperNetConfig with Swin backbone configuration for tiny, small, base, or large model variants on ADE20K
reverse_correct_unfold_reduction_order: reverse the unfold-based downsampling weight reordering from mmsegmentation to match PyTorch expectations
